blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang has directed the Department of Health (DOH) to fast-track the processing of legitimate claims under the agency’s Medical Assistance to Indigent and Financially Incapacitated Patients (MAIFIP) program. Executive Secretary Ralph Recto directed DOH regional directors and participating hospitals to verify accounts payable and promptly process valid claims under the program. “Let us continue coordinating with the regional directors, verify the accounts payable, and process the valid claims promptly. These funds are available to support our patients and our partner hospitals,” Recto said in a statement on Saturday. The directive was issued to ensure that government assistance is converted […]...
